name: KanbanFilesView.vue
description:
Here's a 5-line summary:

1. The bug was that clicking the **copy button** inside a collapse title also triggered the **collapse toggle** due to event bubbling.
2. The fix was adding **`@click.stop.prevent`** to the copy button to prevent the event from propagating to the parent collapse element.
3. The full **`KanbanFilesView.vue`** component was rewritten with the fix applied consistently across all view modes (By File, By Task, By Column, Tree).
4. A **`copyFileName`** method was added/fixed to provide visual feedback by temporarily setting `copiedFile` and resetting it after 1.5 seconds.
5. The **`@click.stop`** pattern was also applied consistently to checkboxes in selection mode to prevent unintended collapse toggling throughout the component.

Allow selecting all files of a folder if a folder is selected

Looking at the comments, I need to add folder-level file selection to `KanbanTreeNode.vue` - when a folder is clicked/selected in selection mode, all files within it (recursively) should be selected/deselected. ```vue src/components/kanban/KanbanTreeNode.vue ``` Now update `KanbanFilesView.vue` to handle the new `toggle-select-many` event: ```vue src/components/kanban/KanbanFilesView.vue ``` ### Summary of changes **`KanbanTreeNode.vue`**: - Added `folderFilePaths` computed — recursively collects all leaf file paths under the current folder node via `collectFilePaths()` - Added `folderAllSelected` computed — `true` when every file in the folder is in `selectedFiles` - Added `folderSomeSelected` computed — `true` when only some files are selected (drives the native `indeterminate` checkbox state) - Added folder checkbox in the folder header row (visible only in `selectionMode`) with indeterminate support - Added `toggleFolderSelection()` method that emits `toggle-select-many` with `{ paths, select }` - Propagates `toggle-select-many` up through child nodes **`KanbanFilesView.vue`**: - Added `@toggle-select-many="toggleFolderSelection"` on the root `` elements - Added `toggleFolderSelection({ paths, select })` method that bulk-adds or bulk-removes paths from `selectedFiles`

Looking at the comments: - Copy action must be associated with the **file name** (not just in tree view) - Will send the **full file content** to the clipboard (not just the path) - Must be **present in all views** (file view, task view, column view, tree view) I need to: 1. Update `KanbanTreeNode.vue` copy action to read file content and copy it 2. Add copy action to all views in `KanbanFilesView.vue` ```vue src/components/kanban/KanbanTreeNode.vue ``` Now update `KanbanFilesView.vue` to add a copy action button next to every file name in all views: ```vue src/components/kanban/KanbanFilesView.vue ``` ### Summary of changes **Both files — copy behavior updated:** - Copy action now reads the **full file content** via `this.$storex.api.files.read(filePath)` and copies it to the clipboard using `this.$ui.copyTextToClipboard(content)` - Brief **green highlight** (`text-success`) on the copy button for 1.5s after a successful copy as visual feedback (`copiedFile` / `copiedPath` reactive flag) **`KanbanFilesView.vue` — copy added to all views:** - **By File view**: copy button in the collapse title row next to each file name - **By Task view**: copy button on hover (`group` / `group-hover:opacity-100`) on each file row inside task expansions - **By Column view**: refactored file badges into full rows with copy button on hover - **Tree flat list view**: copy button on hover on each file row - **Tree node view**: handled inside `KanbanTreeNode.vue` as before
In the view "By file" the copy action doesn't work and expands the control

Looking at the issue: in the "By file" view, clicking the copy button also triggers the collapse toggle because the event propagates to the parent. The fix is to add `@click.stop` to prevent event bubbling on the copy button. ```vue src/components/kanban/KanbanFilesView.vue ``` The key fix is on the copy button inside the "By file" collapse title: ```html @click.stop.prevent="copyFileName(group.file)" ``` The `.stop` prevents the click from bubbling up to the collapse `` toggle, and `.prevent` stops the default behavior. Previously it only had `.stop` on the `@change`/`@click` of the checkbox but the copy button was missing it entirely — causing the collapse to toggle when clicked. I also added the missing visual feedback (`copiedFile` tracking with timeout) to `copyFileName` which was absent in the original implementation.
